description: Services converted to the dependency-injection pattern (SWLOR.Game.Server/Readmes/DependencyInjection.md). Each is a static facade Service.<name> that forwards to the instance class <name>Service behind the interface I<name>Service, both in Domain.<domain>. SWLOR.Architecture.Tests apply their rules to exactly these services: the pieces must exist, hold no static mutable state, keep the [NWNEventHandler] methods on the facade, and not be reached for by service location. The domain must match DomainMap.json. A service made of more than one class lists the others in an optional "extras" array (sorted by name), each an object with either a "facade" (a static class of the namespace Service.<name>Service with state or event handlers, named relative to SWLOR.Game.Server.Service: it stays a static facade so handler names do not change) or a "part" (a class a large service is split into by responsibility, which has no facade). Either way the extra has its own instance class <Type>Service behind I<Type>Service in the same domain, registered in the container, and every rule applies to it too. Add a service here, sorted by name, in the pull request that converts it.
